introduction:
Welcome to the GregTech Electrical Safety Board.

Before leaving the Steam Age, you must prove that you can tell a power cable from a very expensive fuse. Previous player didn't finish their application and is now spread across three chunks.

Answer at least 8 of the following 10 questions correctly. Reading tooltips is mandatory, replacing tooltips with guessing is not.
passedMessage:
Congratulations! You are now a Certified GregTech Electrician.

You may leave the Steam Age and begin making expensive mistakes with cables. Your certificate confirms that you knew better. It does not cover replacement machines.
failedMessage:
Certification denied.

Please return to the Steam Age. The boiler would like a word with you, but at least it cannot send you an MV packet.

questions.prompt: What is the maximum voltage of the LV tier?
options: 8 V
Whatever the cable believes in

questions.prompt: What is the maximum voltage of the MV tier?
options: 33 V because it is slightly more medium
Enough to turn an LV machine into a memory

questions.prompt: Four LV generators supply the same cable. Does their voltage add up to MV?
options: No. They can supply more amperage at LV voltage, and you're going to do that a lot here anyway
Yes. Four small numbers always become bigger number
Only if the generators face each other and agree
No, for that you'd need to craft the generators into a 2×2 square first

questions.prompt: An LV machine receives a 128 V packet through an MV-rated cable. What happens?
options: It becomes an MV machine for free
It politely rejects the packet and sends you a warning letter within 7 business days
It works four times faster and thanks you for your generosity
It explodes, as much as you'd like cable's rating does not increase the machine's rating

questions.prompt: Two cables have the same voltage rating, but one supports more amps. What does the higher amp rating allow?
options: Sending a higher voltage safely into the same machine
Carrying more amperage without exceeding the cable's amp limit
Unlocking the cable's management career
Skipping MV because thick cables look like HV cables

questions.prompt: You keep sending 4 A through a cable rated for 1 A. What should you expect?
options: The cable automatically upgrades itself
The extra amps wait in an orderly queue
The cable introduces you to Joule's law
The cable files a complaint but continues working

questions.prompt: Ignoring cable losses, how much power is 2 A at 32 V?
options: 64 EU/t
16 EU/t
128 EU/t
Two electricity. One for each amp

questions.prompt: Why can a long, lossy cable make your machines struggle for power?
options: Electrons need a lunch break after every sixteen blocks
The cable charges rent per machine
Greg noticed you were enjoying yourself
Voltage drops faster than your motivation to finish this modpack

questions.prompt: You have MV power and want to supply LV machines. What is the sensible solution?
options: Connect 4 LV machines in series and hope they share the voltage like good friends
Put a sign saying “32V ONLY” on the generator
You remember how long those machines took to craft and use a transformer
Connect it quickly before the machine notices

questions.prompt: Can a normal LV machine use a cable rated for more amps than the machine needs?
options: No. The cable forces every available amp into the machine
Yes, though Greg is crying over your inefficient resource management
Only after the cable completes this exam too
Yes, but only if you apologize to Ohm
